note: Static map from platform-observable weakness classes to a small cited control catalog. Reviewed like a feed: changes land as data changes. This mapping is evidence support only - it never asserts compliance or certification.

controls.name: Continuous Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Establish a program to continuously assess and remediate software vulnerabilities. Mapped evidence: open critical and high severity findings.

controls.name: Software is maintained and known exploited vulnerabilities are remediated
controls.description: Mapped evidence: open findings whose CVE is in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

controls.name: Securely manage enterprise assets and software
controls.description: Management interfaces and administrative services are not exposed. Mapped evidence: findings about exposed management ports or admin services.

controls.name: Encrypt sensitive data at rest
controls.description: Disk encryption posture is verified, not inferred. Mapped evidence: findings about missing or partial disk encryption.

controls.name: Networks and devices are monitored
controls.description: Endpoint sensors report continuously. Mapped evidence: findings about missing or stale agents that blind the platform.
